data.value:
1. Open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox in Firefox. 2. Click “Load Temporary Add-on” and select manifest.json in the folder above. 3. Return to LightDl and click “Register / repair host”, make sure “Capture browser downloads automatically” is enabled in LightDl.
The bundled Firefox extension is unsigned and can only be loaded temporarily. Reload it after restarting Firefox. Permanent installation requires a Mozilla-signed XPI.
